segments.he: ר' שמואל אייזיק ראה פעם אליהו הנביא רץ ואמר לו להיכן רץ והשיב לו להלב של העולם. ושאל אותו מי הוא הלב של העולם והשיב לו לחסידי ברסלב שהם הלב של העולם.ועוד פ,א ראה אותו רץ ושאלו להיכן רץ והשיב לו לחסידי ברסלב שהם תמיד שותים;
segments.en: The renowned Gaon Reb Gershon Henich of Radzimin — author of the Techeiles — was in Uman at Rabbainu's holy grave and said that it was now resolved for him why people do not travel and the Tzaddikim do not gather at Rabbainu's grave. Because Rabbainu shows the great ones that there is still "no place of His glory" in their attainment — that they are still below and have not yet grasped anything — and he humbles them. Therefore they do not travel and draw close, for who wants to be humbled? But to the small ones he shows that "the whole earth is full of His glory" — that there is still hope for them — and he elevates them. Therefore they travel and draw close.
